market.what: Inhibited PG25 coolant for direct-to-chip (TCS) loops, world
market.method: est. ~9 GW new DLC IT (65k NVL72-class racks x 0.13 MW + others) x ~1 L/kW fill x ~$8/L = ~$75M + recharge/top-up on base ~$25M

value.logic: ~25 GW DLC base by 2030 (est.) x ~$8k/MW-yr: fewer inhibitor tests/recharges and flushes (~$3k) + fewer clog/leak outages (~$5k; 54% of big outages >$100k)
value.revenue_logic: 2032 DLC coolant ~$400M x ~20% inhibitor-package value x ~20% share = ~$16M, sold to blenders (Dow, Dober, Castrol)
value.margin_logic: specialty inhibitor package, small volume, sold to coolant blenders

trend.drivers: AI racks 120-130 kW need cold plates; DLC revenue +85-156% y/y in 2025; Dell'Oro ~$3B (2025) to ~$7B (2029)

competition.notes: Ecolab buying CoolIT for $4.75B (Mar 2026, ~$550M rev) bundles cold plates + fluid + monitoring; ZutaCore $100M Series C (Jun 2026); Corintis $25M A1. BTA depletes into hoses (OCP).

lab.synth: catalog (s0 = glutamate class; amino-acid/azole analogs buyable); 3 variants + PG25 blends
lab.test: ASTM D1384 glassware corrosion (Cu, brass, solder, Al, steel; 336 h) + ASTM G59 polarization + Cu release by ICP-MS; contract lab (e.g. Intertek, SwRI) or univ.
lab.logic: 2 wk buy+blend + ~2 wk D1384 + 2-3 wk electrochem/ICP; ~$1k compounds + 3-4 fluids x ~$2-3k D1384 (est.) + ~$2k ICP/electrochem

sale.gates: elastomer/material compat 1000 h + OCP-style fluid spec; cold-plate/CDU OEM and server OEM approval ~1-1.5 yr; pilot loop 6 mo
